Limit a material edit to selected furniture and check camera and lighting continuity.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Upload the linked kitchen photograph with white chairs.

Source reference images: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/kitchen.webp)

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
In this room photo, replace ONLY the white chairs with chairs made of wood.
Preserve camera angle, room lighting, floor shadows, and surrounding objects.
Keep all other aspects of the image unchanged.
Photorealistic contact shadows and fabric texture.
```

</details>

### Make it your own

Supply your own references, state the role of each, and separate what changes from what must stay.

### Notes

- The original also asks for fabric texture; specify upholstery separately when adapting the wooden-chair requirement.
- Source settings: `size="1536x1024"`, `quality="medium"`.

**原始提示词 · 参考图编辑 · 尚未独立测试**

### 输入要求

- 上传下方带白色椅子的厨房照片。

来源参考图: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/kitchen.webp)

<details>
<summary>提示词</summary>



```text
在这张房间照片中，只将白色椅子替换成木制椅子。
保留相机视角、室内光线、地板阴影及周围物体。
保持图片的所有其他方面不变。
写实的接触阴影和织物纹理。
```

</details>

### 改成你的需求

提供自己的参考图，说明每张图的用途，并分清要修改与要保留的部分。

### 使用说明

- 原文还要求织物纹理；改写木椅需求时，应单独说明是否保留软包。
- 来源参数：`size="1536x1024"`, `quality="medium"`.
